in_marathi.name: Hiranmay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiranmay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'hiran' (gold) and 'may' (shining, radiant). This name is associated with the god Vishnu and symbolizes purity, brilliance, and divine grace.
